reviews.title: Great Value for the Money!
reviews.comment: This computer monitor is exactly what I needed! It displays 1920 x 1080p through its HDMI and VGA ports. I am using it as my server's monitor, as my server only has a VGA port for video output instead of an HDMI port, and it is working fantastically for that use. It was packaged in a very meticulous fashion with pre-fitted styrofoam that really protects it during shipment. Beyond the safe packaging, it seems like it is incredibly durable as well. I was wary of how low-cost this monitor was before purchase, but my fear diminished as soon as I plugged it in and saw how it looked. The quality is really wonderful, and the 100Hz refresh rate is great too! The value of this monitor in relation to the cost is unquestionable, and the colors look great, too. I really appreciate that there are multiple different ports for connectivity, such as VGA/HDMI, as this ensures it will be useful for a long time if I end up using it for something else. If you are looking for a monitor with VGA and HDMI ports, then it goes without saying that this is a great option. The fact that it has a 100 Hz refresh rate is just the icing on top and shows the value that you are getting at this price point. I couldn't be happier with my decision to purchase this monitor, and I look forward to getting many years of use out of it. All in all, I am really impressed by the quality and usefulness of this monitor, especially for the price. I can see myself purchasing from ArcticPro again in the future.
reviews.author: Gage Renn

reviews.title: Good quality monitor for the price!
reviews.comment: Product is good quality and fits my needs! The picture is clear and there are no dead pixels! I wish they would have included mounting screws but I understand that most people are just using the stand that came with the screen. I had to get creative with the screws and bushings that I already have because all the ones I had were either too long or too short.. oh well. It holds well enough! Thanks seller!
